name: Farmer Furlbrow
summary: Near the Jansen Stead, Farmer Furlbrow and his wife are stranded beside their broken wagon. Driven from their northern Westfall farm by the Defias Brotherhood, they hope to reach Elwynn Forest.

sections.title: A Life Packed on a Wagon
sections.body: Theodore Furlbrow left his pumpkin patch in northern Westfall with his wife, Verna, as criminals drove them from their home. They salvaged what they could and set out for Elwynn Forest, urging neighbors such as Farmer Saldean to leave too. Near the Jansen Stead, their wagon broke down, leaving them exposed to bandits and wild beasts. Verna tends to their horse, Old Blanchy, while Theodore keeps watch over the road. He hopes to recover the pocket watch Verna's father gave him on their wedding day and warn Sentinel Hill about the approaching bandits.

sections.title: Evidence of Land Seizure
sections.body: Before the Furlbrows fled, Defias thugs pressured Theodore and took the deed to his farmland, which Verna had cosigned. They thought it would help them forge deeds of their own. The deed can be recovered from the bandits and returned to Theodore. If Westfall becomes fit for honest folk again, it could help the Furlbrows reclaim their land.

faq.answer: Theodore Furlbrow fled his pumpkin farm in northern Westfall with his wife, Verna, after the Defias Brotherhood drove them from their home. They are now stranded beside their broken wagon near the Jansen Stead.

faq.q: Why is Farmer Furlbrow stranded on the road?
aliases: why is furlbrow on the road
faq.answer: Theodore's wagon broke down as he and Verna fled Westfall for Elwynn Forest. They are stranded by the road with their horse, Old Blanchy.

faq.q: What heirloom did Farmer Furlbrow lose?
faq.answer: Theodore lost the pocket watch Verna's father gave him on their wedding day when they fled their farm. He hopes to get it back.

faq.q: Does Farmer Furlbrow have any family outside Westfall?
faq.answer: No relatives outside Westfall are recorded. Theodore's family is his wife, Verna, who is stranded with him beside their broken wagon and their horse, Old Blanchy.

angles.text: As an Alliance citizen, you see how completely civil authority has failed in Westfall. Loyal people must abandon their homes without royal soldiers to defend them.
